item.description:
What's new in 0.1.52

  • Language switching is now fully live everywhere: the "Stay awake for…" duration picker, Quiet Hours weekday letters and times, the weekly stats chart, and the screensaver all follow the chosen language instantly - previously some of these stayed in the launch language until a relaunch.
  • Localized the onboarding tool picker: category headers (AI agents, Runtimes, Builds & compilers…), the RUNNING badge and the "Running now" state.
  • Updates: AwakeMate now checks for a new version automatically every couple of hours and once shortly after launch, showing the update prompt only when there's actually something newer.
  • The software-update window now matches AwakeMate's dark theme.
